in_sanskrit.name: Aruja
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है She who nourishes
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aruja एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Aruja is the wife of Indra, the god of rain. She is also known as Indrani and is the goddess of love, fertility, and nourishment. Aruja is believed to bestow blessings of prosperity, happiness, and longevity.

in_hindi.name: अरुजा
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who knows or fulfills one's desires

She is also known as Indrani and is the goddess of love, fertility, and nourishment. Aruja is believed to bestow blessings of prosperity, happiness, and longevity.
